title: Aerospace stories vs solar energy stories on points
question: Does a story about aerospace get more points than a story about solar energy?
author: film-cards
hypothesis: A story about aerospace gets more points than a story about solar energy.
expect: If true, points per story for aerospace stories should be at least 1.5x the value for solar energy stories, over all stories from 2006 to 2026 (1.1x is weak, 0.9x or lower refutes it).

check.per_label: points per story, aerospace against solar energy

thresholds_note: Thresholds are the ones used on h370, set before this card was run and not tuned to its result. h326 is left unchanged.
caveats: Points are the score each story had when the archive fetched it, so 2025 and 2026 stories may still be gaining points.
A title that names a theme is not proof the story is about it, and one story can sit in both groups.
Both groups are title words only, so stories that never name the theme are missed.
h326 asked a different question; this card compares two groups head to head.
